title: Review NASA POWER request reuse and collect full history

acceptance.text: A checksum-bound, parameter-complete reuse decision and 64-district dry-run provenance plan either support safe resumable full acquisition or stop it before network access with the unresolved official-evidence blocker recorded.
acceptance.evidence: Official POWER Daily, methodology, meteorological-source and OpenAPI v2.10.3 evidence did not supply a parameter-complete point-to-cell equivalence key. Generated a checksum-bound decision, all-64-district/1,600-chunk provenance plan and blocked summary with 1,600 district-year pending records; ten synthetic tests passed, and the exact full command stopped before network access.
